{"command": "gh pr create --base main --head feat/view-context-improvements --title "feat(view-context): classification fix + paned UI + session filters + detail improvements" --body "## Summary

### Classification fix
- \`classifyRequestKind\` now returns \`unknown\` instead of \`main\` when no user-intent text is detected in the last message. Only genuine user-triggered requests get \`main\`.
- \`parseRequestBody\` detects tool-result carriers (OpenAI \`role:tool\` or Anthropic \`role:user\` with only \`tool_result\` blocks) and classifies them as \`tool_result\` instead of \`unknown\`.
- \`extractResponseText()\` added for harvesting title/recap summary text from response SSE/JSON.
- \`updateSessionTitle\`/\`updateSessionSummary\` store methods.

### Paned session detail view
- Split layout: conversation tree (left) + request detail (right).
- Click a request row to see its detail inline — no page navigation.
- Conversation tree uses compact \`conv-row\` design with inline tool previews.

### Detail panel improvements
- **Delivered results** section for \`tool_result\`/search kinds — shows which tool outputs were delivered.
- **Context sent** collapsed by default for non-main kinds.
- **Recap/compact/title** response shown prominently above metadata.
- **Search requests**: show "Search task" block, grep/glob/file summary, and label response as "Search results".
- **Client-side gzip decompression** via \`DecompressionStream\` + \`extractDisplayText()\` parses Anthropic SSE and OpenAI/DeepSeek JSON to show human-readable text.

### Conversation tree grouping
- Consecutive \`tool_result\` and \`search\` requests collapse into a single group row showing aggregate cost/tokens/tools.
- **Expand all / Collapse all** buttons at the top.

### Sessions page overhaul
- **Card-row layout** with title, summary snippet, provider badge, meta line, and inline stats (reqs, cache%, cost, duration).
- **Filter bar**: provider dropdown, CWD dropdown (with session counts), min reqs, min cache %, sort order, reset.
- **Cascading filter counts** — selecting a provider updates CWD dropdown counts and vice versa.
- **Cache % badge**: green (\(\ge\)80%), yellow (40-79%), red (<40%).
- **Provider badges**: color-coded pills (opencode=blue, claude=amber, stackpilot=purple, npx=green).

### Files changed
- \`src/parse/parse.ts\`, \`parse.test.ts\` — classification logic + tests

- \`web/app.js\` — all UI changes
